description: Produce docs/architecture/P12_TWAMM.md: full architecture for the oracle-less TWAMM executing huge fractionalized orders across blocks. Must cover the Uniswap v4 hook lifecycle, the time-weighted slice schedule, transient-storage (TSTORE/TLOAD) sub-order state, and how solver agents capture the deterministic price impact of upcoming sub-orders one block ahead to neutralize slippage internally. Done: reviewed doc with block-by-block execution flow diagram, solver interaction sequence, and stated impact_cap and slice_count gate semantics.
title: Draft TWAMM architecture spec

description: Define the hook interface ITwammHook, slice schedule structs (amount, interval, start block), order registration events, and the solver callback ABI in onchain/src/p12/interfaces/. Done: interfaces compile under solc 0.8.24, every spec flow maps to an interface function, and event schemas are fixed for indexer consumption.
title: Define TWAMM hook interfaces

description: Model the economics: 8 bps protocol fee to Treasury 0x09E2891432827D8835d2E9b83B25e2a5ba9612Ac, solver rebate split for internalized slippage, and micro-arb revenue projections per order-size band. Done: fee accrual formulas plus a sensitivity table over slice_count and volatility regimes with a minimum viable order size.
title: Model economics and 8 bps fee structure

description: Create the repo skeleton: onchain/src/p12/, src/sincor2/agents/p12_twamm/, config/agents/, tests/pytest/test_p12_*.py stubs, scripts/deploy_p12.py stub. Done: directories exist, import paths resolve, and pytest collects the stub files with zero errors.
title: Create P12 repo layout

description: Fill the skeleton with compiling boilerplate: an empty TwammHook.sol extending BaseHook with correct permission flags, a Python solver-agent skeleton with error handling and TOA hook stubs, and config/agents/p12-twamm.yaml with dry_run=true. Done: hook compiles under solc 0.8.24, the agent module imports cleanly, and CI picks up the new test files.
title: Write compiling hook and agent boilerplate

description: Build the Uniswap v4 hook skeleton in onchain/src/p12/TwammHook.sol (forked from SharedLiquidityHook.sol patterns): correct hook permissions, beforeSwap/afterSwap wiring for sub-order execution, ReentrancyGuard, SafeERC20, and non-bricking try/catch on pool interactions. Done: hook compiles under solc 0.8.24, deploys against a v4 PoolManager mock, and registers orders without executing them yet.
title: Build Uniswap v4 hook skeleton

description: Implement the transient-storage execution state: TSTORE/TLOAD-based sub-order queue and per-block execution cursor, so multi-block order state never touches persistent storage mid-execution. Done: sub-order state round-trips through transient storage across the block boundary in tests, with a gas benchmark proving the transient path beats the SSTORE baseline and the overhead budget documented.
title: Build transient-storage execution state

description: Implement the time-weighted slice scheduler: splits a registered order into N slices over the configured block interval, enforces the slice_count gate, handles remainder dust on the final slice, and guarantees no single-block dump. Done: a registered order of arbitrary size produces exactly the scheduled slice sequence in simulation, with remainder accounting exact to the wei.
title: Build time-weighted slice scheduler

description: Build the A2A solver-agent integration in src/sincor2/agents/p12_twamm/solver.py: solver agents read the upcoming sub-order one block ahead, capture its deterministic price impact, and neutralize slippage internally before the slice executes. Done: dry-run solver demonstrates impact capture on a scripted slice sequence with error handling, TOA hooks, and structured logs.
title: Build one-block-ahead solver integration

description: Implement impact caps: per-slice maximum price impact (impact_cap gate), per-order cumulative cap, and a kill switch pausing new slices when abnormal impact is detected. Done: a slice breaching the cap reverts with a named error and the kill switch halts the schedule while preserving already-executed slices for orderly settlement.
title: Implement impact caps and kill switch

description: Implement the 8 bps fee logic: fee accrued per executed slice, solver rebate accounting, and routing of the protocol cut to Treasury 0x09E2891432827D8835d2E9b83B25e2a5ba9612Ac via pull-based claim. Done: fee math unit-checked per slice and a FeeRouted event fires with the exact treasury address.
title: Implement 8 bps fee and rebate logic

description: Handle edge cases: zero-amount orders, dust remainders, order expiry mid-schedule, pool pause during execution, and partial fills. Done: each edge case has a defined behavior documented in code comments and a passing test proving no funds lock and no bricked schedules.
title: Handle TWAMM edge cases

description: Write unit tests under tests/pytest/test_p12_units.py covering hook permissions, transient-storage round-trips, and fee math. Done: all tests pass and the suite runs in CI.
title: Write unit tests for hook and storage

description: Write integration tests under tests/pytest/test_p12_integration.py: register a large order, execute the full slice schedule with the solver agent active, and verify slippage stays within the impact cap. Done: end-to-end dry-run passes with per-slice assertions and solver logs showing internalized impact.
title: Write integration tests for slice execution

description: Write invariant/fuzz tests asserting total executed never exceeds registered amount, transient state is empty after schedule completion, and fees never exceed 8 bps of executed volume. Done: fuzz run completes the configured iteration count with zero invariant violations.
title: Write invariant and fuzz tests

description: Run a Base mainnet-fork simulation: fork at a pinned block, register a large order against a forked v4 pool, execute slices across blocks, and measure realized slippage vs the no-TWAMM baseline. Done: scripts/sim_p12_fork.py runs green with per-slice slippage, gas, and fee revenue logged.
title: Run Base fork simulation of large order

description: Assemble the audit-prep package: frozen code hash, full natspec, threat model (transient-storage misuse, solver collusion, hook permission escalation, reentrancy across slices), findings tracker. Done: audits/p12/ is complete and every external call documents its trust assumptions.
title: Assemble audit-prep package

description: Remediate all findings: fix, add regression tests per finding, update the threat model. Done: findings tracker shows every item closed with a linked test and the full suite passes on the remediated tree.
title: Remediate audit findings

description: Gas-optimize the hook hot path with special attention to transient-storage overhead: minimize TSTORE/TLOAD slots, pack transient state, benchmark per-slice gas. Done: before/after gas report shows the transient overhead minimized with no behavior change and all tests green.
title: Optimize transient-storage gas overhead

description: Write technical docs under docs/p12/: system overview, hook API reference, solver-agent behavior spec, and slice math reference. Done: docs build without warnings and every public function documents parameters and revert conditions.
title: Write technical documentation

description: Ship config/agents/p12-twamm.yaml (slice params, impact caps, solver cadence, dry_run default, TOA hooks) and docs/ops/P12_RUNBOOK.md (order registration, solver ops, kill-switch procedure). title: Ship agent YAML config and ops runbook

description: Add dashboard/monitoring hooks: structured JSON logs for order registration, per-slice execution, realized slippage, solver PnL, and fee accrual in the SINCOR dashboard feed format. Done: dry-run emits sample payloads validating against the feed schema.
title: Add dashboard and monitoring hooks
